score.signal: confidence where the route reports one

notes: The thresholds named in question_types are pre-tuning assumptions, so evaluate them on your own labeled cases; they live in constants.template.ts, which is the single place holding them. A verdict of review is what a below-threshold answer turns into, and it is the path a person has to complete. A route that returns no distribution (T3 emulation on a general language model) cannot fill the signal for choice or score, so every such answer takes review; the route block records the tier so a caller can check before branching.
